decisions.reason: As a close-to-core software product that fits the firm's move toward connected and data-driven infrastructure, it is likely to stay above aspiration or to be supported by organizational slack.

This safety-oriented hardware add-on is less central to the firm's digital trajectory, but its usefulness in bundled infrastructure projects still makes retention slightly more likely than withdrawal.

Given its niche character, lower apparent prominence, and weaker fit with the firm's current software- and control-focused direction, it is more likely to fall below aspiration and have its resources reallocated.

Control technology for water engineering machinery remains strategically central to the firm's established systems business and strongly aligned with its future direction, so management would keep it.

Flow measurement automation and system software is close to the core offer and to the firm's data-driven strategy, so boundedly rational management would continue it while expected returns are learned.
